variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Dried chicken meat (24%), tapioca, animal fat (chicken oil)*, dried peas, potatoes, dried fish (anchovies 8%), pea fibre, animal fat (duck oil) , dried carrot, fish oil (salmon oil) , dried apple pulp, dried pineapple, potato protein, minerals, xylo-oligosaccharides (XOS 0.4%), Yucca schidigera , dried green tea leaves (0.015%), products and by-products derived from the processing of fresh fruits and vegetables (melon juice concentrate – Cucumis melo cantalupensis – source of superoxide dismutase 0.005%), powdered milk protein**. *Refined to 99.6%, preserved with natural antioxidants. **Sources of protein (digestibility >85%).

Analytical constituents: Crude protein 24%, crude fibre 5.8%, crude fat 20%, crude ash 5.9%, calcium 0.6%, phosphorus 0.3%, potassium 0.8%, sodium 0.09%, n-3 fatty acids 0.86%, n-6 fatty acids 3.27%.

Additives: Nutritional additives: Vitamin A (retinyl acetate) 18,000 IU, vitamin D3 1,000 IU, selenium (sodium selenate 0.27 mg) 0.1 mg, manganese (manganese sulphate monohydrate 77 mg) 25 mg, copper (copper(II) sulphate pentahydrate 39 mg) 10 mg, iron (iron(II) sulphate monohydrate 249 mg) 82 mg, iodine (anhydrous calcium iodate 7.3 mg) 4.8 mg, L-carnitine 90 mg, taurine 2,500 mg. TECHNOLOGICAL ADDITIVES: Tocopherol extracts from vegetable oils.
